column1: # The resolved value of a longhand where it is not its computed value (CSS Object Model, section 9, and the specifications that call a property a "resolved value special case property").
# One row per longhand: property, category, source, sentence. A property with no row is `computed`: "Any other property: The resolved value is the computed value."
# category is one of the CSS_RESOLVED_* names of src/css/cssom_computed_internal.h, lower case without the prefix.
# source is the served document the sentence is quoted from (tools/css/gen-cssom-tables.py --served DIR reads DIR/<source>.html and fails on a sentence the text does not contain).
# A row whose sentence the served text does not contain does not exist.
